config.initialization: fresh matching pretrained CodeBERT; identical seed42 linear head

input_protocol.pooling: mean over unique source positions; repeated prefix/BOS/EOS averaged across windows

config.encoder_precision: FP32 weights/optimizer; BF16 CUDA autocast; FP32 head/pooling/loss

vat.precision: FP32 auxiliary encoder/head; float64 Bernoulli KL and perturbation norms
vat.norm: per function L2 over expanded actual encoder tokens, including overlapping-window copies
vat.sampling: one view per original function per epoch; deterministic rotation through original and fixed random views
vat.eligibility: same nonempty surface-site functions in all four controls; others retain BCE

config.augmentation: up to eight per-binding/name/multiple inline comment/combined proposals; no BPE buckets; fixed random up to two views
config.function_name: input-only current declaration name; external APIs/callees unchanged
config.loss: mean BCE over effective views per function; VAT on one deterministic rotating view per function per epoch
config.selection: original clean Valid MCC threshold/epoch and tie-break; no Test
